coverage_gaps: Universe is still hardware-heavy; Layer 1B inputs did not provide enough node-level candidates for AI power equipment, liquid cooling, grid interconnect, data-center electrical balance-of-system, thermal materials, or vertical AI software.
Need current market-cap and analyst-coverage verification for every candidate, especially Taiwan, Europe, Switzerland, UK, and micro-cap names.

Need primary-source verification from company filings, exchange announcements, earnings transcripts, investor presentations, and customer disclosures for Powertech, Aeluma, Aixtron, Oxford Instruments, and Huber+Suhner.
Need clearer separation of training-driven versus inference-driven AI demand because HBM, custom silicon, Ethernet networking, photonics, power, and software beneficiaries may diverge.
Need Taiwan/Korea/Japan OSAT, substrate, bonding, test, probe-card, and photonics suppliers beyond the US-listed universe.

Need pricing checks before Layer 2: revenue growth, backlog conversion, gross margin, valuation multiples, short interest, estimate revisions, capex cycle, and whether each bottleneck is already widely priced.

Need falsification plans for each node: customer insourcing, rapid competitor capacity additions, falling lead times, margin compression, alternative technology substitution, delayed AI capex, or lack of product-level AI revenue.

memory_update.text: AI universe should be split into reference demand anchors and underfollowed chokepoint suppliers; mega-cap AI leaders should not crowd out OSAT, test, photonics, compound-semiconductor equipment, and connectivity nodes.
Memory bandwidth and HBM can create second-order bottlenecks in probe cards, HBM inspection, backend test, OSAT overflow, advanced packaging equipment, and conventional DRAM/NAND outsourcing.

AI optical interconnect and CPO lanes should track not only laser/component suppliers but also upstream MOCVD, III-V process equipment, bonding, substrates, photodetectors, and connectivity components.
Current merged universe lacks enough candidates in power, cooling, grid, data-center electrical equipment, thermal materials, vertical AI software, and AI data infrastructure.
Layer 2 should verify each underfollowed candidate against primary filings, current market cap, analyst coverage, backlog, margin trend, customer exposure, and product-level AI revenue.

summary: Merged Layer 1 AI universe prioritizing Serenity chokepoint relevance across AI compute, custom silicon, foundry/advanced packaging, memory/HBM backend, semiconductor test, photonics/CPO, optical components, and upstream compound-semiconductor equipment. The universe deliberately keeps reference leaders for demand and capacity context while emphasizing underfollowed second-order suppliers where AI demand may surface through bottlenecks, capacity crowding, qualification, yield, or test complexity.
